$comment: Contract vectors for @intellectif/lk-practice (criteria 11, 12 and 16), generated by scripts/contracts-vectors.mjs and run by vectors/replay.mjs. `decompose` runs decompositionRequest, checkDecomposition, admitExtension and composeGraph, then (with `steps`) a record against the composed graph and a full replay. `generate` runs `steps` through createPractice(config), plans `request`, then runs generationRequest for the target of `targetSkill` (with the fields of `target` over it, under `requestConfig` when given), checkCandidates, admitCandidate for each proof with a record of each admitted item, and a record of each accepted candidate stored without a proof. `grade` runs checkGradeResult over `rows` and evidenceFromGrade over `evidence`. `outcome` (M10) runs evidenceFromOutcome over `evidence`, whose outcomes lk-core made where it makes them, and skillOutcomesFromCriteria over `criteria`. A call that throws is recorded as its error name. Floats compare at a relative 1e-9; integers, strings, null and every time exactly.
